raw_knowledge_statement: Given a response $y$ to a query $x$, its likelihood under the policy $\pi_\theta$ is denoted as $\pi_\theta (y | x)=\prod_{t=1}^{|y|} \pi_\theta (y_t | x, y_{<t} )$ where $|y|$ denotes the number of tokens in $y$.
fact: According to the paper "Group Sequence Policy Optimization", the likelihood of a response $y$ to a query $x$ under the policy $\pi_\theta$ is denoted, using the token-level autoregressive factorization over the tokens in $y$, by $\pi_\theta (y | x)=\prod_{t=1}^{|y|} \pi_\theta (y_t | x, y_{<t} )$
